overview.heading: Built for Sustainability-Mandated Capital
overview.intro: Every allocator with a climate mandate faces the same question about Bitcoin: prove it. SBP answers with data, not narratives.

cards.title: SFDR Article 8 & 9 Funds
cards.body: Attestation records built to feed EU sustainability disclosure workflows — audit-ready inputs for reporting and filings.

cards.title: Pensions & Endowments
cards.body: Fiduciary-grade audit trails and independent third-party verification that stand up to investment committees and consultants.

cards.title: Sovereign Wealth & Insurance
cards.body: Multi-jurisdiction compliance documentation for allocators operating under ESG disclosure mandates across the GCC, EU, and North America.

operatingModel.heading: From Megawatts to Mandate-Ready
operatingModel.intro: Three steps take raw energy data to an investable SBP token.

steps.title: Verify
steps.subtitle: Energy Source Verification
steps.body: Metered energy data is collected from mining infrastructure and matched to proof of clean energy consumption.

steps.title: Attest
steps.subtitle: Cryptographic Attestation
steps.body: Verified data is cryptographically signed, timestamped, and anchored on-chain — an immutable record that cannot be retroactively altered.

steps.title: Enable
steps.subtitle: Institutional Integration
steps.body: Attestations are minted as SBP tokens that plug directly into institutional compliance workflows.

standards.heading: Built on the frameworks allocators already trust

items.title: GHG Protocol Scope 2
items.body: Claims follow Scope 2 Guidance, so miners make unique, exclusive clean-energy claims.

items.title: RE100-Aligned
items.body: Miner requirements built on the most widely adopted corporate clean-energy framework.

items.title: Energy Attribute Certificates
items.body: Globally accepted instruments substantiating energy generated, delivered, and consumed.

items.title: Independent Audit
items.body: Auditor-agnostic protocol, verified by third parties with energy and emissions expertise.
